approach: Static recompilation of the ARM9 code to C++, melonDS core as hardware runtime, SDL2 frontend
notes: Plays on one screen: the two DS screens are merged into one 16:9 layout per situation (overworld, battles, menus), with a widescreen 3D renderer and 60 fps frame interpolation. A setup program recompiles and builds the game on the player's machine using their own copy; no game code is distributed. Made with heavy use of AI: nearly all of the code was written by an AI coding assistant (Claude), directed and play-tested by the maintainer.
